title: A novel ROR1-targeting antibody-PROTAC conjugate promotes BRD4 degradation for solid tumor treatment.
one_sentence_reason: Reports new in vitro (affinity, internalization, degradation, cytotoxicity) and in vivo (antitumor efficacy, PK, safety, combination with anti-PD1) data for a specific novel ROR1-targeting degrader-antibody conjugate (a BRD4-degrading PROTAC payload rather than a classical cytotoxin); flagged as a genuine payload-modality judgment call, but this non-standard "degrader-antibody conjugate"/PROTAC wording (no vedotin/deruxtecan-style suffix) is precisely the kind of construct a keyword-based search would likely miss.
